C-FLAG-HONESTY.Summary: Make citty boolean flags refuse the space-separated true/false form (`--flag false`) with a loud error that names the two working forms, so a surface cannot silently invert operator intent — fixing F18 as a class across every boolean flag in the CLI, not as a one-off for gate `--record`.
C-FLAG-HONESTY.Problem:
RM-GOVERNED-PATH P0 is blocked from COMPLETE by, among other findings, F18: a flag surface that accepts an instruction, reports success, and does the opposite. That is the product's honesty thesis turned against its own argv.
Verified defect (decisions.md F18). citty parses `type: "boolean"` flags positionally-blind. The space form `--record false` yields `record: true` and swallows bare `false` as a discarded positional. Working forms are `--record=false` (equals) and `--no-record`. Measured table from the finding:
| Form | args.record | effect | | `--record false` | true | records (writes run-ledger.xml) | | `--record=false` | false | does not record | | `--no-record` | false | does not record |
Live consequence: `ngrace gate archive --change C-TOKEN-INTEGRITY --record false` appended a Decision to an **archived** bundle's run-ledger.xml during what the operator believed was a read-only probe. No error, no warning, mutated ledger. The danger is silence, not the parser quirk.
This is not a documentation gap. A skill note that says "use the equals form" leaves the trap armed for every operator who does not read it. The wrong form must become loud.
The instance is `--record`; the class is every citty boolean flag. Measured at authoring HEAD by `rg -n 'type: "boolean"' src/` (denominator and per-file counts taken from that full listing, not a truncated match head — F12.2):
**22 boolean flags in 9 files:** grace-cursor.ts 4, grace-verification.ts 3, grace-module.ts 3, grace-lint.ts 3, grace-file.ts 3, grace-graph.ts 2, grace-context.ts 2, grace-status.ts 1, gates/command.ts 1.
Of those 22, **exactly one defaults to true:** gate `--record` (default true). The other 21 default false. The space form still forces the flag **true** (presence of `--flag` sets true; the bare token is not the value), so `--apply false` silently enables a write path the operator believed they disabled. Default-true is the sharpest edge (silent write when asked not to); default-false still silently inverts "I meant false" into true.
A fix that repairs only `--record` and leaves twenty-one live instances has fixed a symptom. This bundle specifies the class.

Goals.Goal: The space-separated boolean form (`--<flag> true` / `--<flag> false`) fails loudly for every citty boolean flag in the CLI: non-zero exit and a message that names both working forms (equals assignment and the `--no-<flag>` / bare-flag forms as applicable), without performing the flagged side effect.

Working forms continue to work: `--flag=true` / `--flag=false`, `--no-flag` where citty provides it, and the bare `--flag` (presence means true). Proven on at least one default-true flag and one default-false flag.

Legitimate positionals and subcommand tokens are not broken — including a free-form positional whose value is literally the word true or false, and `ngrace gate <approve|apply|archive|verdict>` subcommand resolution via rawArgs (A31.4).

Coverage is the class of all boolean flags declared under src/ (inventory re-derived from code at implementation time, not a hand-maintained name list that drifts). A one-flag special case for `--record` alone fails the goals.

Constraints.Constraint: Binding: decisions.md F18 (defect), F12.2 (measure denominators; do not invent counts), F10 / F10.3 (probe claims about the code before writing them), F23 (when a surface or criterion reports a number, pin it exactly — not a lower bound). plan.md §1 P0 board: F18 is one of five open findings blocking COMPLETE. Spec only in this authoring pass; status remains "draft"; do not author plan.xml until the spec is approved (F4 two-stage).

Behaviour, not mechanism. Feasibility note only: context.rawArgs is already reachable inside a citty run(context) and is already used at gates/command.ts:326 (A31.4 subcommand detection). Whether the guard lives in a shared helper, a defineCommand wrapper, or per-command wiring is a **plan-level** decision. The plan must not invent a new graph module or new V-M-* without a stop-and-report; prefer an existing M-* host (see Assumptions).

Which bare token is an error: a bare token equal to true or false (case-sensitive ASCII) that is the **intended value of a boolean flag** — i.e. appears in raw argv immediately after a token that is a declared boolean flag in long form without an equals value (`--record` then `false`), not any bare true/false anywhere. Subcommand names, free-form positionals, and unrelated string args must keep working.

Refuse, do not guess. On the forbidden form the process must exit non-zero **without** performing the side effect the flag controls (for `--record`, no Decision append to run-ledger.xml). Inferring the operator meant false and proceeding, or silently rewriting the argv and continuing, both fail — that is the original defect with better manners.

Class coverage. The inventory of 22 flags / 9 files is the measured denominator at authoring; the plan and tests re-derive the count from `type: "boolean"` declarations under src/ at implementation time (F12.2). A hand-maintained list of flag names that drifts from the code fails the class criterion. Adding a new boolean flag after this lands must fall under the same guard without a second special-case patch — the plan chooses how.

AffectedAreas is a closed list and binds the plan (change.plan-scope-exceeds-spec). A plan that needs a module not named here is a stop-and-report, not a silent expansion. Under-declaring costs a re-spec; over-declaring grants scope nobody reviewed.

Overlap note: C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE (active draft, no plan) declares AffectedAreas M-GATES and M-REVIEW. This bundle also names M-GATES. If both are planned with overlapping ObservedWriteScope on gates/*, sequential OWS (F10.2 style) is required — known now rather than discovered at plan time. Do not absorb C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE subject matter (three-exit ledger reads).

Archives under .ngrace/changes/archive/ and docs/plans/archive/ are never edited. No CHANGELOG.md edit (D5.5 — new surface text in commit body). No package version / marketplace / openpackage version surface change. No skills/ or plugins/ skill-text change in this bundle.

Evidence doctrine: red-first regressions for each AC. Where a criterion asserts a count (flag inventory, exit code, decision-append absence), tests pin exact values (F23: toBe / exact absence, not toBeGreaterThanOrEqual). Measure inventory denominators with their own full-listing commands (F12.2).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Changing any flag's default (including gate record default true). The defect is silent mis-parse of the space form, not the default policy.
Renaming, removing, or adding boolean flags; introducing gate --dry-run; rejecting unknown flags beyond the space-form boolean trap.
Migrating off citty, forking citty, or making the equals form (`--flag=false`) an error. Equals and --no-flag remain first-class working forms.
A documentation-only or skills/-only "fix" (skill text is a product change and would belong in its own bundle). Leaving the trap armed while telling operators to avoid it fails the goals.
C-LEDGER-READ-ABSENCE scope: three-exit ledger reads (absent / unreadable / ok) for wrapperFromLedger and related gates/ledger.ts surfaces.
Other open P0 findings (F9.9 attempt-pair wording, F20 cloneXmlNode home, F21 fix-budget attempts vs failures, F22 paused-pending-approval self-clear).
New graph modules, new V-M-* verification anchors, CHANGELOG.md edits, version bumps, marketplace/plugin packaging changes.

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SPACE-FORM-FAILS-LOUD: Given any citty boolean flag declared under src/, invoking the CLI with the space-separated form `--<flag> false` or `--<flag> true` (two argv tokens: the long flag without `=`, then bare true/false) exits non-zero and emits a message that names **both** working forms: (1) the equals form `--<flag>=false` / `--<flag>=true` and (2) the negation or bare form as citty provides (`--no-<flag>` and/or bare `--<flag>`). The process must **not** perform the side effect controlled by that flag. For the F18 incident shape specifically: `ngrace gate apply|archive|approve --change C-* --record false` must not append a Decision to run-ledger.xml. **Failure conditions:** exit 0; exit non-zero without naming both working forms; silent proceed with inferred intent (including rewriting to equals and continuing); recording or other flagged side effect still occurring; a message that only says "invalid arguments" with no usable forms.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-WORKING-FORMS-BOTH-DEFAULTS: On a flag that defaults **true** (gate `--record`) and on a flag that defaults **false** (e.g. cursor regenerate `--apply` or graph split `--apply`): (1) `--flag=false` yields false behaviour; (2) `--flag=true` yields true behaviour; (3) `--no-flag` (where citty exposes it) yields false behaviour. Gate with `--record=false` must not write a Decision; with `--record=true` or default it may write when the gate otherwise permits. **Failure conditions:** either default class broken; equals form rejected; `--no-record` rejected; gate still writes under `--record=false`.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-BARE-FLAG-STILL-TRUE: The bare flag without a value still means true: `--record` alone keeps default-true recording behaviour; `--apply` alone keeps enable-write behaviour on a default-false apply flag. **Failure conditions:** bare flag becomes an error; bare flag is treated as false; bare flag requires equals.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-LEGITIMATE-POSITIONALS: Legitimate non-flag tokens keep working after the change: (1) `ngrace gate approve|apply|archive|verdict …` still resolves the subcommand (A31.4 rawArgs first non-dash token; parent does not print bare usage when a known subcommand ran); (2) free-form citty positionals that can be the literal words true or false still work when they are **not** the value of a boolean flag — measured inventory of type: "positional" at authoring: 7 declarations (grace-module.ts query/target×2, grace-verification.ts query/target×2, grace-file.ts target) — e.g. `ngrace module find true` treats true as the search query (may return empty/not-found, but must not raise the boolean space-form error); (3) a bare true/false that is not immediately after a boolean flag token is not rejected solely for being the word true/false. **Failure conditions:** gate subcommands fail to resolve; module/verification/ file positionals with value true or false are rejected with the boolean-form error; a naive "any bare true/false is an error" rule that breaks positionals.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-CLASS-COVERAGE: The guard applies to the **class** of all citty boolean flags under src/, not only `--record`. At implementation close, the measured count of `type: "boolean"` declarations under src/ (full listing; F12.2) is the coverage denominator; every declaration is subject to AC-SPACE-FORM-FAILS-LOUD. Proof may be a shared guard plus a structural/inventory test that fails when a new boolean flag is added outside the guard, or exhaustive per-flag coverage — plan chooses. **Failure conditions:** only gates/command.ts `--record` is fixed; a new `type: "boolean"` under src/ can ship without the loud refusal; coverage is a hand-maintained name list that can drift from `rg -n 'type: "boolean"' src/` without a red test.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SUITE-AND-LINT: Red-first regressions cover each AC above with exact assertions where a number or presence/absence is claimed (F23 — no toBeGreaterThanOrEqual on inventory counts, exit codes, or Decision append counts). bun test for touched packages green; bun run validate:ci green; bun run ngrace lint --path . is 0 errors and 0 warnings; ngrace review --path . is 0 findings on a clean tree after the change. No edits under docs/plans/archive/ or .ngrace/changes/archive/; no CHANGELOG.md; no version / marketplace / openpackage version surface; no skills/ or plugins/ skill-text edits. **Failure conditions:** suite red; lint or review dirty by design silence (disabling checks); archive or changelog or version edits; skills changed in this bundle.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red-first CLI/unit regressions: space form `--record false` and at least one default-false boolean exit non-zero, name equals and --no-/bare forms, and (for record) leave run-ledger.xml without a new Decision; equals and --no-record / bare --record keep working on default-true and default-false; gate approve|apply|archive|verdict still resolve; free-form positional `true`/`false` on module find (or equivalent) does not raise the boolean space-form error; class-coverage / inventory test tied to `type: "boolean"` under src/ (exact count at close, F12.2/F23). Existing V-M-GATES, V-M-CURSOR, V-M-STATUS, V-M-QUERY, V-M-LOCALIZE, V-M-LINT-CORE, V-M-CONTEXT command surfaces; no new V-M-*. Dogfood: ngrace lint --path . 0/0; ngrace review --path . 0 findings; validate:ci green.

Assumptions.Assumption: Preferred host for a shared guard (if the plan chooses one): M-QUERY via src/query/errors.ts or a new src/query/* file with LINKS M-QUERY — already imported by gate, cursor, status, lint, context, and query CLIs through runGraceCommand / GraceCommandError. A new graph module or new V-M-* is a stop-and-report. Per-command wiring without a shared helper is allowed if AC-CLASS-COVERAGE still holds.

Positional inventory at authoring (`type: "positional"` under src/): 7 — module find query; module show target; module health target; verification find query; verification show target; verification localize target; file show target. All free-form (search string, module/file/verification target, or path) and **can** legitimately be the words true or false. No other rawArgs consumers under src/ at authoring.

citty space-form behaviour for booleans (presence ⇒ true; following bare true/false is not the flag value) is the defect under test; the working forms equals and --no-* are citty's supported boolean spelling. No boolean flag currently declares an alias at authoring.
